manchester_h4_0.text: Eccles cakes come from Eccles, just down the road. Currants in flaky pastry, buttery and dangerous.
The Ship Canal opened in 1894 and turned Manchester into a port, 36 miles from the sea. Cheek of it.

then.text: You have had one, our kid. Save some for the rest of Manchester.

else.text: Take an Eccles cake for the road. Go on, you look peckish.
